coordinate_policy: GeoJSON layers must carry documented WGS 84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326); unknown or other CRSs are not guessed or reprojected by this project.

datasets.title: National Hospital Directory with Geo Code and additional parameters
datasets.publisher: National Institute of Health and Family Welfare (NIHFW), hosted by Government of India Open Government Data Platform
datasets.license: Government Open Data License - India, stated by the portal resource metadata
datasets.crs: Unknown from accessible resource metadata; field described as Location_Coordinates
datasets.units: Location_Coordinates; coordinate order/units not established from accessible metadata
datasets.geographic_coverage: India-wide; district/state fields permit filtering in principle
limitations: The Ernakulam subset contains 180 records; 31 have missing/nonnumeric coordinate pairs and 18 exact repeated coordinate-pair groups cover 63 rows.
Although 149 remaining pairs pass generic latitude/longitude numeric ranges, this does not establish order, CRS, datum, correctness, or facility location.
The source may be incomplete or stale; current operational status and capacity are not independently confirmed.
A review-only processed CSV preserves the source coordinate string and QA flags; no point geometries were created and it is not displayed as a spatial asset layer.

The official Kerala Health institution search page provides an identity/address cross-check with View Map controls but no accessible GIS export or published coordinate semantics/accuracy/reuse terms; no coordinates were adopted from it.
datasets.blocker: NIHFW coordinate order, CRS/datum and positional accuracy remain undocumented. The Kerala Health alternative is an official directory, but its reviewed page exposes no reusable GIS file or coordinate metadata; therefore no facility points are eligible for raster sampling.

datasets.title: Kochi Corporation ward boundaries (2022 community repackaging)
datasets.publisher: DataMeet Municipal Spatial Data; README says scraped from Kerala OpenSDI KSUDP_KCH_Ward_Boundary
datasets.publication_date: Not stated; dataset-specific README says wards as of 2022
datasets.license: CC BY-SA 2.5 India; stated by dataset-specific DataMeet README; attribution and share-alike apply
datasets.crs: EPSG:4326 / WGS 84 per GeoJSON RFC 7946 semantics; no explicit CRS member in source
datasets.geographic_coverage: Source-declared Kochi Municipal Corporation wards; observed bounds 76.2373589?76.3400293 E, 9.8934161?10.0497693 N
limitations: Community repackaging of a Kerala OpenSDI source; the live source service and current ward register were not cross-checked.
Source is one Feature JSON object per line rather than a FeatureCollection; the processed copy normalizes this structure.
Three of 77 source polygons self-intersect and are excluded from the map copy; six records lack Ward_No and Ward_Name. No missing identifiers were inferred.
Processed subset is incomplete and not a legal/current boundary, coverage mask, hazard layer, or input to exposure calculations.
Source scale, positional accuracy, current validity and exact publication date are unstated.
datasets.blocker: Integrated as a contextual map layer, with 3 invalid polygons excluded and 6 records missing ward attributes; do not use for legal boundaries or exposure analysis.

datasets.title: KSDMA Ernakulam historic and RCP 8.5 flood products / flood return-probability rasters
datasets.publisher: Kerala State Disaster Management Authority (KSDMA); page cites UNEP, UN GRID, CIMA Italy, KSDMA (2020) and RMSI / National Insurance Academy (2024) for return-probability products
datasets.publication_date: Ernakulam PDFs linked under 2022/05 path; historic raster ZIPs linked under 2026/06 path; exact dataset publication dates not stated
datasets.license: No dataset-level reuse licence found on the reviewed KSDMA page
datasets.crs: EPSG:4326 / WGS 84 explicitly present in each GeoTIFF GeoKeyDirectory
datasets.units: Single-band float32 raster; pixel-value meaning, units, and NoData semantics are not documented in the inspected metadata
datasets.geographic_coverage: Downloaded raster grid bounds approx. 74.8646216–77.3680 E, 8.2909–12.7667 N (statewide grid extent, not hazard footprint); Kochi coverage of valid hazard pixels not established
limitations: Archive CRC passed; it contains three 3004×5371 single-band float32 GeoTIFF files at approx. 0.000833333 degree cells, labeled 10-, 25-, and 50-year historical products.
Dataset-level reuse permission is not stated on the KSDMA catalogue; source archive is preserved raw and not unpacked into processed layers.
Pixel-value semantics/units and NoData meaning are absent; do not threshold, polygonize, or use the raster for overlay until KSDMA confirms metadata and reuse.
Return-period labels describe a scenario product, not event timing or observed flood depth.
The in-repository Ernakulam_map_dataset_draft.zip states its OCR/table alignment is unverified and includes no hazard geometries; it is not used.
datasets.blocker: The linked archive was downloaded and its GeoTIFF CRS/schema inspected. No dataset-level reuse terms or pixel/NoData semantics were found; therefore it is retained raw but not ingested, rendered, or used for exposure.
datasets.archive_integrity: ZIP CRC passed; three TIFF members readable

datasets.title: JRC / Copernicus GloFAS global river flood depth (RP100)
datasets.publisher: Copernicus Emergency Management Service; European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC)
datasets.publication_date: Dataset version 2.1.2; README updated 2026-01-12; RP100 tile directory lists these tiles modified 2025-12-18
datasets.license: README states no restrictions, free and open Copernicus product; JRC copyright notice states CC BY 4.0, attribution and indication of changes required
datasets.crs: EPSG:4326 / WGS 84 confirmed from GeoTIFF GeoKeyDirectory; longitude/latitude georeferencing
datasets.units: Modeled flood water depth in metres; single-band float32; GeoTIFF GDAL_NODATA=-9999
datasets.geographic_coverage: Tiles ID185 N20_E70 and ID186 N10_E70; together cover the Kochi latitude band and 70?80 E tile; preview limited to the provisional boundary bounding rectangle for display only
limitations: Modeled river-flood scenario, not an observation, forecast, warning, damage estimate, or site-specific engineering assessment.
JRC README notes only land areas are covered and warns that unrealistic high depths can arise from modeling, DEM sinks, tile boundaries, or DEM issues.
Spurious-depth and permanent-water auxiliary masks were not downloaded; model artifact flags cannot be applied.
Preview transparency combines zero, NoData, and outside coverage; transparent pixels do not establish safety.
No validated hospital/critical asset locations are available, so no asset-level exposure analysis is claimed.
The preview uses the bbox of the provisional self-intersecting boundary for rendering only, not as a mask.
datasets.analysis_status: Hazard raster preview integrated; asset-level exposure is unknown/unassessable because no independently validated facility-location layer is available.
